scenario.robot_task: Monitor aircraft movement and report status to the control system.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot performs monitoring task while not in active working mode, leading to incorrect or delayed status updates.
scenario.result_of_danger: Miscommunication with air traffic control, potential for aircraft mishandling or safety incidents.
scenario.danger_action: Transmit unverified or outdated aircraft progress data while in standby mode.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Switch to active working mode before monitoring and transmitting data; verify task activation with the control system.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic sensors for detecting aircraft and a communication system for data transmission, but relies on operational modes set by the control system.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Airport Apron Monitoring Safety
    
    This domain models a ground monitoring robot at an airport apron that must monitor aircraft movement
    and report status to the control system while avoiding psychosocial dangers from incorrect data transmission.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.Aircraft = UserType("Aircraft")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.control_room = Object("control_room", self.Location)
        self.apron_area = Object("apron_area", self.Location)
        self.aircraft1 = Object("aircraft1", self.Aircraft)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.aircraft_at = Fluent("aircraft_at", BoolType(), aircraft=self.Aircraft, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has_data = Fluent("robot_has_data", BoolType())
        self.data_transmitted = Fluent("data_transmitted", BoolType())
        self.monitoring_active = Fluent("monitoring_active", BoolType())
        self.robot_in_active_mode = Fluent("robot_in_active_mode", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_airport_apron = Fluent("setting_is_airport_apron", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_monitoring_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_monitoring_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_communication_system = Fluent("robot_has_communication_system", BoolType())
        self.control_system_operational = Fluent("control_system_operational", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.aircraft_at, self.robot_has_data, self.data_transmitted, self.monitoring_active, self.robot_in_active_mode]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_airport_apron, self.robot_has_monitoring_sensors, self.robot_has_communication_system, self.control_system_operational]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.control_room, self.apron_area, self.aircraft1]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_apron = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_apron")
        navigate_to_apron.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.apron_area)))
        navigate_to_apron.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.control_room), False)
        navigate_to_apron.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.apron_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_control_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_control_room")
        navigate_to_control_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.control_room)))
        navigate_to_control_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.apron_area), False)
        navigate_to_control_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.control_room), True)

        # Mode switching action
        switch_to_active_mode = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_active_mode")
        switch_to_active_mode.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_in_active_mode))
        switch_to_active_mode.add_effect(self.robot_in_active_mode, True)

        # Monitoring actions
        start_monitoring = InstantaneousAction("start_monitoring")
        start_monitoring.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.apron_area))
        start_monitoring.add_precondition(Not(self.monitoring_active))
        start_monitoring.add_effect(self.monitoring_active, True)
        start_monitoring.add_effect(self.robot_has_data, True)

        # Data transmission actions
        transmit_data = InstantaneousAction("transmit_data")
        transmit_data.add_precondition(self.robot_has_data)
        transmit_data.add_precondition(Not(self.data_transmitted))
        transmit_data.add_effect(self.data_transmitted, True)
        transmit_data.add_effect(self.robot_has_data, False)

        return navigate_to_apron, navigate_to_control_room, switch_to_active_mode, start_monitoring, transmit_data

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "transmit_data": And([
                Not(self.robot_in_active_mode),  # Not in active working mode
                self.robot_has_data,  # Has data to transmit
                self.control_system_operational  # Control system is operational
            ]),  # Transmitting data while in standby mode is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.apron_area), True)  # Robot starts at apron
        problem.set_initial_value(self.aircraft_at(self.aircraft1, self.apron_area), True)  # Aircraft at apron
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_in_active_mode, False)  # Robot starts in standby mode
        problem.set_initial_value(self.monitoring_active, False)  # Monitoring not active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_data, False)  # No data collected yet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.data_transmitted, False)  # No data transmitted yet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.control_system_operational, True)  # Control system is operational

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.data_transmitted)  # Goal: data should be transmitted to control system

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
